  PROBLEM: The OpenCode verdict fallback uses the writer agent profile and a writable sandbox source mount, allowing the model to modify the code snapshot it is judging.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1439-1442 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: `RB_JUDGE_OPENCODE_CONFIG` is generated but never consumed, and a failure generating this unused config exits the script before the verdict attempt.
  WHY: The severity is disputed: deepseek rates this MAJOR and z-ai rates it NIT. A generation failure can prevent the judge from running even though the verdict sandbox uses a different config.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1439, 1547 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The verdict sandbox config `RB_JUDGE_SANDBOX_OPENCODE_CONFIG` is referenced before being prepared.
  WHY: The review says this may cause sandbox setup to fail or run with an empty or missing configuration.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:718 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Claude setup guard checks for the absence of `ai:codex` but not the presence of `ai:engine-claude`, causing unnecessary setup when no issue requires Claude.
  WHY: The severity is disputed: deepseek rates this NIT and gemini rates it MAJOR. The review describes wasted work, while noting that the later engine-resolution gate preserves behavior.
